retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist two-panel composition featuring a dark silhouette against a vibrant red field, balanced by a wide white margin for clean typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast graphic featuring a black silhouette of a human figure with arms raised, set against a large, textured red square. This red block is positioned on the left, leaving a significant white vertical gutter on the right side for branding and text.
coreVisualRelationships: The black silhouette is anchored to the bottom edge of the red field.
The red square occupies approximately 75% of the horizontal width.
Typography is strictly aligned to the top-right white space.
A sharp vertical boundary separates the red field from the white margin.
coreInvariants: The silhouette must remain a solid, detail-free black shape.
The red field must have a subtle, painterly texture rather than a flat digital fill.
The layout must maintain a wide white vertical column on the right.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The silhouette is large-scale, cropped at the waist and arms, filling the lower half of the red field.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bottom-left corner of the red square acts as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the dark silhouette up through the red field to the text in the upper right white space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white right-hand margin provides significant breathing room and structural balance.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against low value black and high value white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century Swiss style and clean grotesque proportions.
Provides a slightly more rugged, classic American jazz feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a large red square with a subtle canvas texture on the left 75% of the frame. Place a solid black silhouette of a man with arms raised at the bottom of the red square. Leave the right 25% of the frame as a solid off-white vertical strip.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, black, all-caps sans-serif text in the top-right white area, aligned left within that column.

verificationChecks: Is the red field textured rather than flat?
Is the silhouette completely black without internal detail?
Is the text restricted to the white margin area?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name
Ensure the silhouette is a generic figure

mustAchieve: High contrast between black and red
avoid: Overlapping text on the red field
Multiple colors beyond red, black, and white

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the red square
Verify text is flush left in the white column
Ensure no facial features are visible in the silhouette
Confirm the red has a tactile, printed quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Red square + Black silhouette + White margin + Bold Sans-Serif = Mid-Century Jazz Aesthetic
